capabilities: search MusicBrainz for music releases by artist, title, or both
create notes with release metadata, genres, and tracklists
download cover art locally to the vault
customize note output via template variables, custom fields, or a template file
add configurable tags and file name templates to generated notes
disambiguation: Not a general in-vault search tool; it queries the external MusicBrainz database and creates new release notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents all template variables, including date-format tokens, and describes both custom-field and template-file modes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up music release metadata from an external database and generate structured notes for albums, EPs, or singles.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that searches the MusicBrainz database and creates structured notes for music releases.
Rich metadata: genres, tracklist, release date, cover art, MusicBrainz/Discogs/Wikipedia links
Wikidata / Wikipedia — Wikipedia article links via Wikidata sitelinks

summary: Searches the MusicBrainz database for music releases and creates notes with metadata, cover art, and links to Discogs and Wikipedia.
